 November Supplemental Security direct payment worth up to $994 goes out in 12 days
 By Mackenzie Chase 
 Published
 October 18, 2026 9:00am ET
 Advertisement -->
 Advertisement 
 Add Washington Examiner on Google
 The November 2026 Supplemental Security Income payments, worth up to $994 for an individual filer, will be sent to recipients in 12 days.
 SSI payments are typically issued on the first day of each month, or on the last business day of the prior month if the first day falls on a federal holiday. Nov. 1 is a Sunday, so recipients will receive their benefits on Oct. 30.
